newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says has new Moomba oilfield.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says has new Moomba oilfield.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Monday it had made a new oilfield discovery within South Australian petroleum exploration licences (PEL) 5 and 6 which flowed 4,200 barrels of oil per day from a drill stem test.

Santos, the operator of the Cooper Basin region, said the Carmina One discovery well flowed 51.2 degree API oil through a half inch choke from the interval 1,499 metres to 1,507 metres in the Jurassic Hutton sandstone. The well is located about 40 km south of the Moomba gas plant.

"While the field is relatively small, the proximity to existing infrastructure will facilitate early production," Santos said. Santos has an 88.25 percent stake, with Boral Ltd unit Boral Energy holding seven percent and Clyde Petroleum Plc unit Crusader having 4.75 percent.
